programs.title: China's Home Front Ep.8
programs.desc: An authentic, multidimensional and vivid picture of China during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression explains the role of the home front while paying tribute to the sacrifices of millions of ordinary people.

programs.title: Echoes of Traditional Chinese Music Ep.4
programs.desc: Explore the enduring legacy of traditional Chinese music through five renowned classical pieces, from grand compositions, landscapes and emotion to folk traditions and pivotal moments in history.

programs.title: The Journey of Rice Ep.4
programs.desc: By tracing how rice spread from China to dining tables around the word, reexamine the evolution of Chinese civilization and its global influence.

programs.title: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain
programs.desc: Porcelain has shaped the culture of the whole world. The wisdom behind each of 72 procedures has been refined from generation to generation. The times may change, some techniques may change, but what remains the same is the burning flame of the kiln that keeps setting so many hearts on fire for this ancient craft.

programs.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programs.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York's. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.
